landing.personalDescription: Typing the same passage again is not always the next step. Look at the keys that slow you down and give them a little more attention.
landing.personalDetail: TypeFlow connects practice, results and recommendations so you can understand what to work on, rather than only watching a speed number.
landing.noticeCopy: Your errors and timing help reveal which parts of the keyboard need attention.
landing.targetCopy: Use the recommended activity to focus on the skills you are still developing.
landing.reflectCopy: Review completed sessions to see how your accuracy and speed change over time.
landing.questionsDescription: A few things to know about learning with TypeFlow.
landing.keyboardQuestion: Can I practise on my phone?
landing.keyboardAnswer: Typing practice is designed for a computer with a physical English QWERTY keyboard. You can browse the website on a phone, but use a computer for a typing session.
landing.languageQuestion: Which language will I type in?
landing.languageAnswer: Exercises use English text and an English QWERTY layout. You can use the website interface in English or Arabic; the exercise text stays English and reads left to right.
landing.mistakesQuestion: What happens when I make a mistake?
landing.mistakesAnswer: You get feedback while typing and can correct your text. Your completed result still accounts for the original mistakes, so focus on accurate, comfortable typing before speed.
landing.accountAnswer: Create an account to start your learning and keep your completed sessions connected to you. If you already have an account, log in to continue.
landing.footerDescription: A little focus, a clearer next step, and room to improve at your own pace.
landing.footerNote: Built for thoughtful practice, one session at a time.
landing.touchDescription: Learn the home keys by touch and build the muscle memory for English typing.
landing.historySpeedTitle: A practice trend, at a glance
landing.historySpeedDescription: A sample view of how completed practice sessions can be reviewed over time.
landing.historySessionDescription: A visual sample only. No account result or personal history is shown.
landing.title: Find F without looking.
landing.description: Find your rhythm with English typing practice that adapts to the keys you need to work on. Take it one session at a time.
landing.device: Practise on a computer with a physical English QWERTY keyboard.
landing.exampleLabel: A look inside practice · illustrative example
landing.adaptiveTitle: A saved pattern can shape the next drill.
landing.adaptiveDescription: One mistake explains this attempt. Repeated substitutions in saved evidence may support focused practice.
landing.mismatchNote: The final d is underlined because it differs from the assigned f.
landing.showcaseLabel: Sample product view · not learner data
landing.showcaseDescription: The dashboard brings the next practice step, a compact path and session history together.
landing.focusDescription: F and J help your fingers find their way back.
landing.methodDescription: Your saved typing evidence helps identify patterns worth practising; each result shows what happened before the next recommendation.
landing.practiceDescription: Work through an English passage with clear feedback as you type.
landing.resultDescription: Review your completed session’s speed and accuracy. Corrections do not hide the original mistakes.
landing.nextDescription: Use a recommendation based on your typing to focus your next session.
landing.courseTitle: A learning path made of keys.
landing.courseDescription: The course experience is being built around focused lessons, a learning path for each course, and practice that responds to your needs.
landing.courseStatus: Course experience preview — not a live course listing.
landing.review: Return to keys that need more practice.
landing.progress: Follow your progress through completed sessions.
landing.closingTitle: Make room for a little practice.
landing.closingDescription: Create an account to begin, or log in to pick up your learning.
landing.footer: Adaptive practice for English touch typing.
